content.title: Locked Microperformance | Gaze, Half-Smile, Downward Pause, Open Recovery
content.summary: Hold one uninterrupted close-up on a clearly adult original performer and build the scene from restrained facial changes rather than cuts. Progress through direct gaze, a contained half-smile, a downward glance and quiet pause, then return to an open, stable expression while preserving identity, eyeline, lighting, and framing.

quick_start.input_format: clearly adult original performer + locked uninterrupted close-up + direct-gaze baseline + restrained half-smile + downward glance and pause + open stable recovery
quick_start.recommended_input: A clearly adult night-shift radio engineer with an original face sits in a locked chest-up portrait beside a dim amber console. They meet the lens steadily, allow one restrained half-smile, lower their eyes toward a silent waveform meter, hold a two-beat breath, then look back up with one natural blink and a warmer settled smile. Preserve the same identity, lens height, cool window edge light, amber fill, and uninterrupted framing throughout.
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult subject and stable direct gaze in a locked close-up.
Use one restrained half-smile as the first countable peak.
Return to the same gaze axis with an open attentive expression.
Settle through one small blink or smile into a relaxed terminal hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Hold one uninterrupted close-up on a clearly adult original performer and build the scene from restrained facial changes rather than cuts. Progress through direct gaze, a contained half-smile, a downward glance and quiet pause, then return to an open, stable expression while preserving identity, eyeline, lighting, and framing.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Hold one clearly adult original subject in a stable close-up and establish direct gaze before any emotional peak. Build the performance from countable microchanges: one restrained half-smile, one downward glance with a short eyelid pause, one return to the same gaze axis and one relaxed open recovery. Preserve face, wardrobe, background, exposure and camera position; do not use cuts or large gestures. The reusable mechanism is gaze-based microexpression accumulation and recovery—not the source likeness, hair, earrings, gray garment, pale room, exact lip movement, off-camera partner, timing, creator identity or model claim.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult subject and stable direct gaze in a locked close-up.
invariants.purpose: Creates a facial baseline with no editorial cover.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning mid-expression makes later changes hard to compare.

invariants.rule: Use one restrained half-smile as the first countable peak.
invariants.purpose: Introduces emotional change without abandoning microperformance scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: A broad grin or body gesture turns it into overt acting.

invariants.rule: Lower gaze and hold one short eyelid pause without cutting.
invariants.purpose: Creates a controlled energy drop and proves facial continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut or long head turn hides the transition.

invariants.rule: Return to the same gaze axis with an open attentive expression.
invariants.purpose: Reestablishes the social relation after the pause.
invariants.ablation_failure: Looking elsewhere leaves the performance direction unresolved.

invariants.rule: Settle through one small blink or smile into a relaxed terminal hold.
invariants.purpose: Provides recovery rather than ending on the peak.
invariants.ablation_failure: A frozen peak or abrupt cut prevents emotional closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source face, blonde hairstyle, blue eyes, earrings, skin details and exact identity
the source gray garment, pale interior, blurred partner shoulder and exact conversational setup
the source direct gaze, half-smile, downward glance, eyelid timing, lip movement and facial performance
the source locked framing, exposure, color treatment and exact fifteen-second timing
the source creator identity, platform overlay, model discussion and any watermark
